verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Asana's built-in docs/notes/wiki-style features (e.g., Project Overview pages) that would let a PM create and organize shared notes alongside project work; all API/integration/MCP evidence concerns task/workflow automation, not document creation. One community comment even flags the absence of 'free form notes and wiki' capability in a comparable tool, but this doesn't directly confirm or deny Asana's own doc feature. missing for 10: any first-party documentation of Asana Docs/Project Overview/notes functionality, hands-on evidence of creating/organizing shared docs.
